text: Can you turn this surprised cat pic into a classic meme? I’ve been having one of those weeks where I keep losing track of what day it is. For the top text, use WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY, and keep the image square. The bottom text should be BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY. Make the lettering big, uppercase, and white with black outlines, and don’t let it cover the cat’s eyes. Keep the apostrophes but leave out full stops in the actual meme text; the free-tier image size is fine.
